edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff the total settlement amount of Four Hundred Seventy-Five Thousand Dollars ($475,000) (the “Settlement Amount”) by wire transfer of immediately available funds within five (5) business days after execution of this Agreement by all parties, pursuant to wire instructions provided by Plaintiff’s counsel. The release set forth in Section 2 shall become effective only upon Plaintiff’s cleared receipt of the full Settlement Amount.
edits.name: Section 1 Payment

edits.text: 2. RELEASE. Upon Plaintiff’s cleared receipt of the full Settlement Amount, Plaintiff releases all claims against Defendant arising out of the matters at issue in the dispute.
edits.name: Section 2 Release

edits.text:
4. NO ADMISSION. This settlement is not an admission of liability, wrongdoing, or fault by any party.

5. MUTUAL NON-DISPARAGEMENT. The parties agree that they shall not make, publish, or communicate any false, defamatory, or disparaging statement concerning the other party relating to the matters resolved by this Agreement, except as required by law, court order, subpoena, or legal process.

6. AUTHORITY TO EXECUTE. Each person signing this Agreement represents and warrants that such person has full authority to execute and deliver this Agreement on behalf of the party for whom such person signs and to bind that party to the terms of this Agreement.

7. NO ASSIGNMENT OF RELEASED CLAIMS. Plaintiff represents and warrants that Plaintiff has not assigned, transferred, conveyed, or otherwise disposed of any claim released under this Agreement.

8. FEES AND COSTS FOR ENFORCEMENT. In any action or proceeding to enforce this Agreement, the prevailing party shall be entitled to recover its reasonable attorneys’ fees and costs incurred in connection with such enforcement, in addition to any other relief available at law or in equity.
edits.name: Additional Standard Provisions
